## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete change and link its issue when available.

## Verification

List actual tests and results. State skipped, manual, browser, audio or device
checks separately. Do not infer success from a process merely starting.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Existing tests and acceptance criteria are preserved.
- [ ] New behavior has meaningful, isolated tests.
- [ ] Stop, Undo, approvals and data isolation still work where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, model weights or private logs are included.
- [ ] Third-party code/data is identified and its license notices are retained.
- [ ] Documentation explains any setup or compatibility changes.
